def max_distance(n, a):
    min_index = a.index(1)
    max_index = a.index(n)
    
    # Calculate the initial distance
    initial_distance = abs(min_index - max_index)
    
    # Try swapping the minimum element with the element immediately before it
    if min_index > 0:

a[min_index], a[min_index - 1] = a[min_index - 1], a[min_index]
        new_min_index = a.index(1)
        new_max_index = a.index(n)
        swapped_distance = abs(new_min_index - new_max_index)
        a[min_index], a[min_index - 1] = a[min_index - 1], a[min_index]  # Revert the swap
        
        return max(initial_distance, swapped_distance)
